capabilities: List and sort notes in the current folder
Filter notes by include and exclude title patterns
Show headings from the current file or all folder files as an outline
Open notes and jump to headings by clicking them
Optionally include subfolder notes and format titles in Title Case
extras: Not yet available in the community plugin directory; only manual installation is documented. The author asks for Ko-fi donations.
motivation: The author built it for writers who keep chapters and related files in one folder and want a clean, focused view of their writing project.
problem: The file explorer shows the whole vault, so writers working in a single project folder lack a focused, filtered list of just that folder's notes.
summary: Sidebar pane that lists notes in the current folder with include/exclude title filters, chapter-number sorting, and clickable heading outlines.
